record: P1.11 POST-FREEZE DEFECT - GenBank truth construction
severity: MATERIAL - removes 15 of 79 isolates from every truth-resolved analysis

defect.p6_is: column 7 of the NCBI assembly report = RefSeq-Accn
defect.why_it_works_for_refseq: RefSeq-Accn (NZ_AP040898.1) equals the FASTA defline id
defect.why_it_fails_for_genbank: GenBank assembly reports carry RefSeq-Accn = 'na' on every row; their FASTA deflines carry the GenBank-Accn (column 5, e.g. CM129771.1). The role dict is therefore keyed on 'na' and no replicon in the sequence file receives a chromosome/plasmid role.
defect.consequence: best_chromosome_hit and best_plasmid_hit are both empty for every contig, so every contig of every GenBank-referenced isolate is labelled ambiguous and excluded.
defect.inherited_from: P1.10, where all 39 references were RefSeq, so p[6] always resolved. The GenBank fallback authorised on 2026-08-22 exposed it.

effect_on_the_primary_result.what_it_is: the frozen confirmatory analysis as executed, over 5,586 truth-resolved contigs from 64 RefSeq-referenced isolates
effect_on_the_primary_result.what_it_is_not: an analysis over all 79 sealed isolates
effect_on_the_primary_result.must_be_reported_as: PASS on the 64 isolates whose truth could be constructed; the 15 GenBank-referenced isolates contributed no truth-resolved contig for a technical reason

governance.rule_applied: P1.11 results-integrity rule 8: a genuine post-freeze defect is reported, not silently corrected. Any corrected analysis must be SEPARATELY NAMED and cannot overwrite or replace the primary frozen evaluation.
governance.proposed_corrected_analysis: P1.11-SUPPLEMENTARY-GENBANK-TRUTH: key replicon roles on the accession that actually appears in the reference FASTA - RefSeq-Accn when present, otherwise GenBank-Accn - rerun truth mapping for the 15 isolates only, and report as a separately named supplementary analysis alongside, never replacing, the primary.
